title: A positive new report raises the question: was Reeves undermined by dodgy data? | Heather Stewart

paragraphs.en: The keen new chancellor, John Healey, responded to last week’s better-than-expected economic news by claiming the government was “bringing hope back”. Growth did not plunge as feared after Donald Trump unleashed war on Iran – with GDP expanding at a pretty decent 0.4% in the second quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 热忱的新任财政大臣约翰·希利回应了上周好于预期的经济消息，称政府正在“把希望带回来”。在唐纳德·特朗普对伊朗发动战争后，增长并未如人们担心的那样暴跌——第二季度GDP以相当可观的0.4%速度扩张。

paragraphs.en: But what if we should have held on to a bit more hope all along? A new assessment of the UK’s recent productivity suggests this critical measure of the country’s economic strength may have been systematically underestimated.
paragraphs.zh: 但如果我们本该一直抱有更多希望呢？对英国近期生产率的一项新评估表明，这个衡量国家经济实力的关键指标可能一直被系统性低估。

paragraphs.en: Instead of stagnation, it points to a “meaningful pickup” in productivity since mid-2024, with annual growth of about 1.6% – up from an average of 0.3% in the previous decade.
paragraphs.zh: 该评估指出的不是停滞，而是自2024年年中以来生产率的“显著回升”，年增长率约为1.6%——高于此前十年的平均0.3%。

paragraphs.en: This has very much not been the prevailing narrative since Labour came to power. Indeed, Rachel Reeves spent months last year scrambling to respond to a downgrade in productivity projections from the Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) – from 1.3% annual growth to 1% – with a knock-on effect for the public finances.
paragraphs.zh: 自工党执政以来，这绝对不是主流叙事。事实上，去年雷切尔·里夫斯（Rachel Reeves）花了数月时间手忙脚乱地应对预算责任办公室（OBR）下调生产率预测——从年增长1.3%下调至1%——这对公共财政产生了连锁影响。

paragraphs.en: Other things being equal, weaker productivity means weaker growth, which broadly translates to lower tax revenues and a bigger public deficit.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他条件相同的情况下，生产率疲弱意味着增长乏力，这大体上会导致税收收入减少和公共赤字扩大。

paragraphs.en: The OBR rethink didn’t reflect anything Labour had done, resulting instead from the long-term failure of productivity growth to bounce back after the 2008 global financial crisis. And part of the reason it became so pivotal was because Reeves had left herself so little room for manoeuvre.
paragraphs.zh: OBR的重新评估并非反映工党做了任何事，而是源于2008年全球金融危机后生产率增长长期未能反弹。这件事之所以变得如此关键，部分原因在于里夫斯给自己留下的回旋余地太小。

paragraphs.en: But the productivity downgrade contributed to the gloomy sense that Labour was overseeing an economy beset by intractable long-term challenges. And it increased the size of the tax grab Reeves needed to make at last year’s budget to rebuild the headroom against her fiscal rules and pay for Labour’s welfare U-turn.
paragraphs.zh: 但生产率下调加剧了这样一种悲观情绪：工党正在管理一个受难以解决的长期挑战困扰的经济。它还加大了里夫斯在去年预算中需要进行的加税规模，以重建相对于其财政规则的余地，并为工党在福利政策上的大转弯买单。

paragraphs.en: The new estimates, from the Centre for Economic Performance at the London School of Economics (LSE), where former Reeves advisers John Van Reenen and Anna Valero have now returned to their desks, paint a markedly different picture.
paragraphs.zh: 这些新估计来自伦敦政治经济学院（LSE）经济表现中心（Centre for Economic Performance），里夫斯的前顾问约翰·范·雷南（John Van Reenen）和安娜·瓦莱罗（Anna Valero）现已回到该中心工作。这些估计描绘了一幅截然不同的图景。
